be allergic to seafood: My brother is allergic to seafood, so he never eats shrimp or crab when we go to the night market.
我哥哥對海鮮過敏，所以我們去夜市時他從不吃蝦子或螃蟹。
an allergic reaction: After eating peanuts at the party, Lisa had an allergic reaction, and her face turned red and itchy.
在派對上吃了花生後，麗莎出現過敏反應，臉變得又紅又癢。
be allergic to hard work: My lazy cousin jokes that he is allergic to hard work; whenever there are chores, he suddenly feels sick.
我懶惰的表弟開玩笑說他極討厭工作（對辛苦工作過敏）；每當有家事要做，他就突然覺得不舒服。
on alternate days: To stay healthy, my mother goes swimming on alternate days, so she swims on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
為了保持健康，我媽媽每隔一天去游泳，所以她在星期一、三、五游泳。
alternate layers of pasta and sauce: To make lasagna, you put alternate layers of pasta and sauce in the dish, then bake it with cheese.
做千層麵時，要在烤盤裡一層麵一層醬交替鋪放，然後加上起司烘烤。
an alternate route: The main road was closed because of an accident, so the bus driver had to take an alternate route to school.
主要道路因車禍封閉，所以公車司機必須走替代路線去學校。
alternative energy: Many countries are investing in alternative energy, such as solar and wind power, to reduce air pollution.
許多國家正在投資替代能源，例如太陽能和風力，以減少空氣污染。
alternative medicine: Some patients try alternative medicine like acupuncture when regular drugs fail to ease their pain.
當一般藥物無法減輕疼痛時，有些病人會嘗試針灸之類的另類療法。
have no alternative but to leave: When the heavy rain began and the stadium lights went out, the fans had no alternative but to leave.
大雨開始下、球場燈光熄滅時，球迷們別無選擇只能離開。
an alternative lifestyle: Tired of city life, the young couple chose an alternative lifestyle, living on a farm without TV or the Internet.
厭倦了城市生活，這對年輕夫妻選擇了另類生活方式，住在沒有電視和網路的農場上。
an amateur photographer: My uncle is an amateur photographer who takes pictures of birds every weekend, though his real job is teaching.
我叔叔是業餘攝影師，每個週末都去拍鳥，雖然他真正的工作是教書。
amateur sports: The city built new fields to support amateur sports, so ordinary people can play soccer for fun after work.
市政府建了新球場來支持業餘運動，讓一般民眾下班後可以踢足球同樂。
a very amateur performance: The actors kept forgetting their lines, and the audience agreed it was a very amateur performance.
演員們一直忘詞，觀眾一致認為那是非常不專業的表演。
an ambiguous answer: When I asked if he would come to the party, he only said "maybe" and gave an ambiguous answer.
我問他會不會來派對時，他只說「也許吧」，給了一個含糊的回答。
deliberately ambiguous: The politician's statement was deliberately ambiguous, so both sides could believe that he agreed with them.
那位政治人物的聲明故意模稜兩可，讓雙方都能相信他站在自己這邊。
an ambiguous ending: The novel has an ambiguous ending that can be understood in two different ways, so readers still argue about it.
這本小說有個曖昧的結局，可以用兩種不同方式解讀，所以讀者至今仍在爭論。
an ambitious plan: The young student has an ambitious plan to start his own company and become a millionaire before thirty.
這名年輕學生有個雄心勃勃的計畫，要在三十歲前創業並成為百萬富翁。
an ambitious young lawyer: Kevin is an ambitious young lawyer who works late every night because he dreams of running his own firm.
凱文是個有抱負的年輕律師，每晚工作到很晚，因為他夢想經營自己的事務所。
overly ambitious targets: The company set overly ambitious targets for sales this year, and the workers felt stressed because they could never reach them.
公司今年訂下過於遠大的銷售目標，員工們因為永遠達不到而感到壓力很大。
ample evidence: The police found ample evidence, including fingerprints and videos, to prove that the man stole the car.
警方找到充分的證據，包括指紋和影片，證明那名男子偷了車。
ample time to prepare: Don't worry; you will have ample time to prepare for the speech because it is not until next month.
別擔心，演講要到下個月才舉行，你會有充裕的準備時間。
ample parking space: The new shopping mall offers ample parking space, so drivers no longer need to drive around looking for a spot.
新購物中心提供充足的停車空間，駕駛人不再需要繞來繞去找車位。
of ample proportions: The opera singer was a woman of ample proportions, and her powerful voice filled the whole theater.
那位歌劇演唱家是位體型豐滿的女士，她宏亮的歌聲響徹整個劇院。
an annual report: Every December, the company publishes an annual report that shows how much money it earned during the year.
每年十二月，公司都會發表年度報告，說明這一年賺了多少錢。
annual income: His annual income is about one million NT dollars, which means he earns roughly eighty thousand each month.
他的年收入約一百萬台幣，也就是說他每個月大約賺八萬元。
an annual event: The lantern festival is an annual event in our town, and thousands of visitors come to see it every year.
燈節是我們鎮上的年度盛事，每年都有數千名遊客前來觀賞。
annual leave: Workers in this company get fourteen days of annual leave each year, and many use it to travel abroad.
這家公司的員工每年有十四天年假，許多人用來出國旅遊。
an anonymous donor: An anonymous donor gave the hospital ten million dollars, and nobody knows who the generous person is.
一位匿名捐贈者捐給醫院一千萬元，沒有人知道這位慷慨的人是誰。
remain anonymous: The student who returned the lost wallet wished to remain anonymous, so the school did not announce his name.
歸還遺失錢包的學生希望保持匿名，所以學校沒有公布他的名字。
an anonymous letter: The teacher received an anonymous letter with no name at the bottom, complaining about the noisy classroom.
老師收到一封底下沒有署名的匿名信，抱怨教室太吵。
an anonymous hotel room: After weeks of business trips, every night felt like another anonymous hotel room with plain white walls.
出差好幾週後，每一晚都像是另一間有著單調白牆、毫無特色的旅館房間。
